description: Test cases for ViewModel classes in the Note Organizer Android app, including testing of NotesListViewModel and NoteEditorViewModel functionalities such as querying, creating, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: ViewModelsTest
classes.description: Test suite for validating the behavior of ViewModel classes in the note organizer app.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up in-memory database and repository instances before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: notesListViewModel_setQuery_filters_results_reactively
methods.description: Tests that the NotesListViewModel filters notes based on the query string reactively.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_create_trims_input_and_persists_note
methods.description: Verifies that creating a note trims input fields and persists the note correctly.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_edit_updates_existing_note_and_uiState_emits_note
methods.description: Checks that editing a note updates data and UI state accordingly.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_removes_note_and_calls_onDone
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a note removes it from repository and triggers the callback.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_when_creating_is_noop_and_onDone_called
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete when creating a new note has no effect but triggers callback.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_with_missing_noteId_emits_null_note
methods.description: Checks that missing noteId results in null note emission in UI state.
